trackTitle: Data Structures & Algorithms in C (Master Edition)
description: An exhaustive, enterprise-grade Data Structures and Algorithms curriculum implemented natively in C. Designed for computer science students, competitive programmers, and engineering professionals. Spans 10 master segments covering linear/non-linear structures, searching & sliding windowing, string pattern matching & tries, low-level bit manipulation, advanced range query trees & DSU, graph optimization & flows, dynamic programming masterclass, complete sorting algorithms, output diagnostics, and asymptotic complexity analysis.
